item.title: Primetime, 2026 - ★★½
item.description:
I see that this particular pop culture phenomenon is extremely provocative but between this and Predators from last year I still don’t feel like anyone has done much to consider why we can’t look away and who is responsible for what. 

Great performances here and there is certainly a lot of directing going on but the real events are over cranked so much that it loses any sense of weight it might have achieved from being reality. 

I’m sure that’s the point or something, I dunno.

item.title: Vertigo, 1958 - ★★★★
item.description:
Wow, I’m really glad I took another swing here. It totally worked for me this time. 

It’s made me think the in this age where we worry about and talk about ‘spoilers’ so much, perhaps there are movies which are made better by being spoiled. Movies that reach their heights when you can let go of trying to understand the plot and the twists and just enjoy them as they are. Tenet and The Big Lebowski are two that come to mind right away and I think this one is the same.
